label: Sercomm FGS202 GPON SFP ONT
description: mini-GPON ONT in an SFP module (Lantiq PEB98036, 1 MiB RAM / 8 MiB (MXIC MX25L6405D) flash, eCos) that presents to the host as 2.5G Ethernet; GPON line rate 2.488 Gbit/s down / 1.244 Gbit/s up on sc-apc with no LAN ports and no Wi-Fi, managed over telnet + serial.
